description: An Intrusion Set is a grouped set of adversarial behaviors and resources with common properties that is believed to be orchestrated by a single organization. An Intrusion Set may capture multiple Campaigns or other activities that are all tied together by shared attributes indicating a commonly known or unknown Threat Actor. Clusters imported from STIX Intrusion Set objects. Each cluster keeps the STIX version of the object it comes from (2.0, 2.1, ...) in its `spec_version` meta field.
name: STIX Intrusion Set
